text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
Business:
ADEVARUL
- January-November foreign investment in Romania amounted to $594 million, according to latest statistics.
TINERETUL LIBER
- The National Oil Company got $30 million from the central bank to pay for crude oil imports.
LIBERTATEA
- Petrol shortages have swollen queues at filling stations, with panicked car owners trying to put together petrol reserves to see them through the crisis.
CRONICA ROMANA
- Medicine prices rose by 50 percent after the reassessment of production prices in line with a depreciated leu.
CURIERUL NATIONAL
- Financing of building work on the second reactor at the Cernavoda nuclear power plant is difficult due to Romania's austerity budget.
ROMANIA LIBERA

- The National Oil Company (CRP) has filed a proposal with the finance ministry to increase petrol prices to 1,600 lei per litre from 990 lei due to fluctuation of world crude prices and new leu-dollar rates.
- CRP said it has sustained a montly loss of some 50 million lei at current prices.
- Prices for paid medical services have doubled.
- Sindic judge Ioan Georgiu dealing with the fate of troubled private Banca Dacia Felix said a restructuring plan had failed because the central bank had not supported it.
- The Onesti refinery ceased production due to lack of crude.
General:
ROMANIA LIBERA
- Romania's four liberal parties which did not enter parliament after November 3 general elections meet on December 16 to discuss a merger.
EVENIMENTUL ZILEI
- Four young girls were sold to a Serbian pub owner for the equivalent of $200 each.

- The list of the new cabinet was finalised after talks between the Democratic Convention, the Social Democratic Union and the Hungarian Democratic Union (UDMR) but will not be released until after President-elect Emil Constantinescu is sworn in on Friday.
ADEVARUL
- The outgoing President Ion Iliescu pledged to restructure and renew the Party of Social Democracy (PDSR).
- The upper Senate is expected to elect the parliament speaker on Wednesday, after validation of all seats.

- The UDMR to get the tourism portfolio, the leadership of the Minorities Department and the jobs of state secretaries in education, culture and the European integration ministries, the newspaper says.
ZIUA
- Iliescu has pardoned journalists Radu Mazare and Constantin Cumpana who were sentenced to seven month in jail on convictions for slander.
LIBERTATEA
- Constantinescu is expected to summon party leaders on Saturday for talks on the government programme.
CURIERUL NATIONAL
- Romania's priority will be smooth integration into the EU and NATO, Constantinescu said during a brief visit to Germany.
DIMINEATA
- Iliescu is expected to become the leader of PDSR.

- The CDR's Contract with Romania" which comprises a 200-day set of measures to improve living standards cannot be achieved in four years, the Socialist Labour Party says. ($=3,559 lei) -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
